title: Merlin Lean end-to-end chain (merlin.lean.chain.v1)
description: End-to-end claim composed from per-boundary receipts and the capture's support receipt (docs/design/merlin_lean_verification.md, C10). Verified only if every boundary is verified, each boundary's before is the previous after (by SHA-256), and the support receipt is about the first before.

theorem.description: Lean name of the composition theorem.

chained.description: Every boundary's before is the previous boundary's after, the support subject is the first before, and (with a handoff) the last after is the handoff.

replayed.description: Every claim was rechecked against its bound MLIR and its recorded claim metadata matched the fresh result.

handoff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file handed to the upstream lowering, when the chain was checked against it.
